description: Submit the result of the learner running the capsule in the workspace (Studium NEVER executes). Gates advance on ran && passed: a passing run records the learner's OWN executed result (so a later judgment scene is grounded on it) and advances; a ran:false / failed-checks run does NOT advance. Returns {status: ran|run_incomplete|run_failed_checks|not_a_run_scene, learner_run_recorded, transition?} — transition (redacted) present only on a passing run.
name: submit_run_result
